biggest_catch: Pay per HIT is set by each requester and is often a few cents; requesters have up to 30 days to approve work, so approved cash can take weeks to reach your bank even though the schedule is flexible.
catches: Per-HIT pay is set by each requester (Amazon states no minimum); most small HITs pay pennies, so effective hourly pay is often well below minimum wage.
Requesters 'determine whether to approve your work and pay you within 30 days' — approval is not instant and rejections lower your approval rating, which gates access to better HITs.
New workers face a 10-day holding period before any rewards move to the earnings balance.
One transfer per calendar day; scheduled transfers every 3, 7, 14 or 30 days — this is not same-day cash.
US tax interview (taxpayer ID) is required before you can work on any HIT.
Daily HIT limits apply; MTurk warns about scams/phishing in requester-hosted HITs — never hand personal data to a requester.

steps: Request a worker account on worker.mturk.com (name, email, country; agree to Participation Agreement; decision within 3 business days).
Complete the US tax information interview (required before any HIT).
Browse HITs you qualify for, click Accept & Work, complete per requester instructions, submit.
Requester approves (or auto-approves) within 30 days; approved reward shows on Dashboard/Earnings.
On Account Settings, schedule transfers to your US bank account or Amazon gift card every 3, 7, 14 or 30 days (one transfer per calendar day; 10-day hold for new workers).
timing: Approved HIT rewards credit to your earnings balance; transfer to US bank account or Amazon.com gift card on a schedule you choose (every 3, 7, 14 or 30 days); 10-day holding period for new workers; one transfer per calendar day.
who_pays: The individual requesters who post tasks (HITs) on Amazon Mechanical Turk pay you per approved task; Amazon holds your balance and handles the transfer to your bank.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+ and request a worker account (decision within about 3 business days). US workers must complete the IRS tax information interview before they can do any HIT.
work_available: MTurk is an open task marketplace, but new workers face daily HIT limits and your approval rating gates access to better-paying HITs, so how much work you actually qualify for varies day to day.
what_gets_accepted: Each requester sets the bar for their own HITs and has up to 30 days to approve or reject your work. Rejections don't just lose you that task's pay — they lower your approval rating, which locks you out of better HITs.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join or work — Amazon charges requesters, not workers. Unpaid time: the account request and tax interview, learning which requesters are worth your time, and any HIT a requester rejects (no pay for it).
when_cash_arrives: Approved rewards credit to your earnings balance, then you transfer to a US bank account or Amazon gift card on a schedule you choose (every 3, 7, 14, or 30 days, one transfer per day). New workers have a 10-day holding period before anything moves.

repeatable.cadence: New HITs post constantly — complete a HIT, get it approved, earn the reward, and pick up the next one.
